about_the_game:
Chicken Fries is a first-person fast-food simulator where you build, run, and upgrade your very own fried chicken restaurant. Cook juicy chicken, load up the fryers, shake seasoning over mountains of fries, and assemble orders with satisfying, physics-driven chaos. Every action (pouring soda, smashing patties, bagging meals) feels tactile and hands-on.

COOK, FRY, SEASON

Step behind the counter of a bustling fried chicken shop. Drop frozen chicken pieces into crispy batter, lower baskets into gurgling oil, watch steam burst and oil droplets sparkle, then pull everything out in perfect golden crunch.

SERVE DRIVE-IN AND WALK-IN CUSTOMERS

From the pickup window to the drive-in lane, customers roll up with big orders and little patience. Take tickets, prep meals fast, and keep the line moving to earn tips and upgrades.

SATISFYING PHYSICS AND CHAOS

Spilled seasoning, foamy soda overflows, bouncing fries, and messy prep stations. Your kitchen feels alive: every item reacts with playful, exaggerated physics that make even mundane tasks feel fun.

BUILD YOU FAST FOOD EMPIRE

Upgrade machines, customize your kitchen, unlock new menu items, and expand your restaurant from a tiny corner shop to a full fast-food powerhouse.

SMOOTH FIRST-PERSON GAMEPLAY

Unity-powered visuals and a grounded first-person perspective put you directly in the apron. Look down at your hands, grab ingredients, and run the shop exactly like a real employee, just with way more fun.
